Full Stack Engineer
Ledgerline | London (Hybrid, 3 days a week in our Shoreditch office)
Salary: £50,000 - £60,000 per annum

About Ledgerline
We build reconciliation software for mid-sized accountancy firms. Our platform is used by 300 practices across the UK.

The role
You'll join a team of six engineers and own features end to end, from the Python API to the React front end.

Requirements
- 3+ years of commercial experience building web applications
- Strong Python and PostgreSQL
- Production experience with React and TypeScript
- Comfortable writing unit tests and reviewing code

Nice to have
- Docker and AWS
- Experience with Celery or similar task queues

Working here
Hybrid working, with three days a week in the office. 25 days holiday plus bank holidays.

Unfortunately, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.
